```{r,echo=F}
options(scipen=999)
pn = function(c,d){
    p = paste0("{",c,"}x^{",d,"}",collapse="+")
    p = gsub("x^{0}","",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("x^{1}","x",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("+{-","-{",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("+{1}x","+x",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("-{1}x","-x",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("{-1}x","-x",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("{1}x","x",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("x^{1}","x¹",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("x^{2}","x²",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("x^{3}","x³",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("x^{4}","x⁴",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("x^{5}","x⁵",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("x^{6}","x⁶",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("x^{7}","x⁷",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("{","",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("}","",p,fixed=T)
    return(p)
}

x = sample(2:5,1)*sample(c(-1,1),1)
while(T){
    cfs = sample(2:9,4)*c(1,sample(c(-1,1),3,T))
    f = cfs[1]*x^3+cfs[2]*x^2+cfs[3]*x+cfs[4]
    if(abs(f)<1000 && abs(f)>0){
        break
    }
}

while(T){
    R = sample(1:9,1)*sample(c(-1,1),1)
    c3 = sample(2:9,4)*c(1,sample(c(-1,1),3,T))
    c1 = c(1,sample(2:9,1)*sample(c(-1,1),1))
    d3 = 3:0
    d1 = 1:0
    c4 = rep(0,5)
    for(i in 1:4){
        di = 4-i
        for(j in 1:2){
            dj = 2-j
            dk = di+dj
            k = 5-dk
            c4[k] = c4[k]+c3[i]*c1[j]
        }
    }
    c4[5] = c4[5]+R
    if(min(abs(c4))>0 && abs(R)!=abs(c1[2])){break}
}


a1 = "x"
a2 = paste0(c1[2])
a3 = pn(c3[1],3)
a4 = pn(c3[2],2)
a5 = pn(c3[3],1)
a6 = pn(c3[4],0)
a7 = pn(c4[1],4)
a8 = pn(c3[1]*c1[2],3)
a9 = pn(c3[2],3)
a10= pn(c3[2]*c1[2],2)
a11= pn(c3[3],2)
a12= pn(c3[3]*c1[2],1)
a13= pn(c3[4],1)
a14= paste0(c3[4]*c1[2])
a15= paste0(R)



answers = c(a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7,a8,a9,a10,a11,a12,a13,a14,a15)

ach = sort(unique(answers))

sols = character()
for(i in 1:length(answers)){
    sols = c(sols,paste0(1*(answers[i]==ach),collapse=""))
}

al = paste0("* ",ach,collapse="\n")
```
